questions.question: Match the command to the function.
questions.question_norm: match the command to the function

pairs.answer: asks the name server for information on the destination domain
displays the route that is taken to the destination

questions.raw_answer: netstat → displays network connections; ipconfig → displays IP settings on host; nslookup → asks the name server for information on the destination domain; ping → tests end-to-end connectivity between hosts; tracert → displays the route that is taken to the destination
